fusions.name: Spadework
fusions.desc: Digs the blade in for 4 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Landslide
fusions.desc: Heaves a slide of silt over every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 30 damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Pit Dug Ahead
fusions.desc: Digs a pit under the nearest enemy. It waits 2 minutes, and the first 2 enemies to come within 3 tiles take 24 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Buried Deep
fusions.desc: When your health runs low, you regain 4 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 90 seconds.
